name: Medicine Ball Single-Arm Slam
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and cradle a dead-bounce medicine ball in one hand, steadying it with your other hand.
Lift the ball overhead and take your supporting hand away once you have control.
Bend your hips and knees and drive the ball into the floor just ahead of your feet.
Pick the ball up smoothly with a flat back to reset, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your feet clear of the landing spot.
Engage your abs and lats to drive the slam downward rather than bending strictly from your lower back.
